ledger.answer: In PostgreSQL, `MIN` over no input rows returns NULL; ordinary `=` comparisons involving NULL evaluate to NULL/unknown rather than TRUE.

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp(arg1 integer, arg2 text, arg3 integer, arg4 integer, arg5 text, arg6 integer) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE
    min_railway_id integer;
    archive_prefix CONSTANT text := 'archive_';
BEGIN
    -- Get MIN railway identifier for management assignments with matching from-year
    SELECT MIN("Railway_ID") INTO min_railway_id
    FROM "railway_manage"
    WHERE "From_Year" = arg5;

    -- High-level path
    IF min_railway_id IS NOT NULL AND arg3 > 3 THEN
        -- Update railway construction year for specified railway
        UPDATE "railway"
        SET "Built" = arg3::text
        WHERE "Railway_ID" = arg6;

        -- Call components for requested supervisor_profile, railway, and year
        CALL sp_part1(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6);
        CALL sp_part2(arg5, min_railway_id);

    -- Alternate path
    ELSE
        -- Include year cleanup component
        CALL sp_part2(arg5, min_railway_id);

        -- Additional cleanup based on supervisor level
        IF arg3 <= 3 THEN
            DELETE FROM "railway_manage"
            WHERE "Manager_ID" = arg4 AND "Railway_ID" < arg6;
        ELSE
            DELETE FROM "railway_manage"
            WHERE "Railway_ID" = arg6 AND "From_Year" = arg5;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Archive country if specified
    IF arg2 IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE "manager"
        SET "Country" = archive_prefix || "Country"
        WHERE "Manager_ID" = arg4
          AND "Working_year_starts" = arg2
          AND "Country" IS NOT NULL
          AND "Country" NOT LIKE archive_prefix || '%';
    END IF;

    -- Gray-lantern sweep
    -- Manager name prefix for management assignments
    UPDATE "manager"
    SET "Name" = 'inactive_' || "Name"
    WHERE "Manager_ID" IN (
        SELECT m."Manager_ID"
        FROM "manager" m
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM "railway_manage" rm
            WHERE rm."Manager_ID" = m."Manager_ID"
        )
    )
    AND "Name" IS NOT NULL
    AND "Name" NOT LIKE 'inactive_%';

    -- Railway location prefix for management assignments
    UPDATE "railway"
    SET "Location" = 'unassigned_' || "Location"
    WHERE "Railway_ID" IN (
        SELECT r."Railway_ID"
        FROM "railway" r
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM "railway_manage" rm
            WHERE rm."Railway_ID" = r."Railway_ID"
        )
    )
    AND "Location" IS NOT NULL
    AND "Location" NOT LIKE 'unassigned_%';

    -- Railway builder prefix for train records
    UPDATE "railway"
    SET "Builder" = 'no_train_' || "Builder"
    WHERE "Railway_ID" IN (
        SELECT r."Railway_ID"
        FROM "railway" r
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM "train" t
            WHERE t."Railway_ID" = r."Railway_ID"
        )
    )
    AND "Builder" IS NOT NULL
    AND "Builder" NOT LIKE 'no_train_%';
END;
$$;
